audit_scope: Official-source metadata review, immutable local acquisition, workbook-structure inspection, strict-window field quality, duplicate/grain analysis, business-rule reconciliation, and monthly coverage are complete. Historical record-overlap and outcome-blind context-feasibility checks remain pending.

decision.decision_summary: Provisionally select the strict prior-period portion of UCI Online Retail II because it preserves the required business fields through three explicit header aliases, moves the study to earlier transaction rows, and is conditionally suitable for aggregate business analysis after documented quality controls. Record independence is not yet proven.

allowed_time_window.reason: The current BizHallu source begins on 2010-12-01. The strict end-exclusive cutoff prevents intentional calendar overlap before record-level fingerprint checks are run.

decision.claim_limit: This is a same-retailer, same-source temporal internal replication. It cannot establish cross-dataset, cross-company, or unseen-domain generalization.
decision.why_not_current_rows: New question families over the current 541,909 rows would be prospective at the question level but would still reuse the exploratory transaction population.
decision.why_not_external_first: Complete Journey is a strong external candidate, but its discount and returns semantics require a new metric map. The prior-period UCI source is the lower-risk way to validate the corrected sampling, split, annotation, and comparison protocol first.
decision.gate_completion_rule: Keep dataset_source_selected_and_audited pending until zero normalized record overlap and outcome-blind feasibility for at least 36 disjoint contexts are proven. Acquisition, hashing, workbook structure, strict-window completeness, duplicate/grain handling, cancellation/value rules, and monthly coverage are complete.

candidates.name: UCI Online Retail II, strict prior-period window
known_strengths: same required business fields after deterministic Invoice, Price, and Customer ID header aliases
prior periods allow transaction-level temporal separation
small enough for the local Windows and 5070 Ti workflow
the strict prior-period window contains 502,938 date-valid rows before any outcome-based filtering
known_risks: same retailer and source lineage, so this remains internal replication
the first workbook sheet extends through 2010-12-09, so 22,523 rows in that sheet and all 541,910 rows in the second sheet must remain outside the strict window

36 context feasibility is plausible but not yet measured
candidates.recommended_use: Use the documented strict-window controls, then proceed to protocol-pilot, development, and sealed confirmation design only after zero historical record overlap and outcome-blind 36-context feasibility are proven.

required_local_profile_checks.requirement: Download online_retail_II.xlsx only from the official UCI source, record retrieval date, byte size, and SHA-256, and keep the workbook out of Git.
Record workbook sheet names, dimensions, headers, inferred types, and parsing warnings before filtering.
Retain InvoiceDate >= 2009-12-01 and < 2010-12-01; report excluded rows on both sides of the window.
Measure null and blank rates overall and by month for every required field, especially Description and CustomerID.
Measure exact duplicate rows and candidate invoice-line key duplication; define rather than assume the analytical grain.
Profile negative, zero, and extreme Quantity and UnitPrice values; compare cancellation-prefix rows with negative-quantity rows.
Normalize shared fields and prove zero exact record fingerprints against the current Online Retail raw and cleaned lineages after the strict cutoff.
Report monthly row, invoice, customer, product, country, cancellation, and monetary totals to identify sparse or abnormal periods.

Generate outcome-blind candidate context counts for each planned question family and prove at least 6 pilot, 15 development, and 15 confirmation contexts can be assigned with period and evidence-fingerprint separation.
Keep raw customer and invoice identifiers out of public artifacts; use aggregates or study-local opaque identifiers.

reject_or_redesign_if: record overlap remains after the strict cutoff
missingness or duplicate ambiguity prevents deterministic evidence calculations
fewer than 36 eligible contexts can be formed without looking at generated answers
the proposed period split produces materially sparse or incomparable business scopes
fallback_order: revise context definitions within the strict Online Retail II prior-period window without viewing model outcomes
use current Online Retail rows only for protocol development, not sealed confirmation
audit Complete Journey as a separately scoped external replication source
